hypotheses: Confidence-oriented continuation can improve usable recall without adding runtime heads.
Matched no-smoothing versus smoothed continuations test objective/policy tension; negative-focused versus ordinary no-smoothing continuation tests combined negative exposure/hard-mining intervention.

parent.reason: Start from the verified human-only foundation, not epoch44's synthetic continuation, so the new candidates do not inherit the supplemental historical val/test/blank gap-fill recordings omitted here. New candidates are mixed-source fine-tunes, not human-only models.

data.references: Recheck all 23315 parent train references against the archived approval, then preserve admitted typed references exactly; no model-based relabeling.
data.gap_fill: Conservative new-version restriction: retain QA-approved gap-fill rows only when the publisher historical manifest_split is exactly train. Omit val/test/blank rows without treating them as negatives. The publisher calls the supplemental corpus train-only for the current benchmark; historical fields are not proof of current overlap.
data.unresolved: 521 unresolved references, including six conflicting train timers, remain excluded; no review template is treated as a completed review.
data.no_new_audio: No TTS, splices, source downloads or invented negative labels.
data.reserved: All current dev/calibration/test/holdout membership and eligibility unchanged. Metadata and byte hashes may be read for integrity; no test/holdout PCM decoding or inference before selection.
data.normalization: Inherit the exactly reconstructed equal-utterance human1889 train-only normalizer, unchanged; no inference-only transform change.
data.voice_alias_limit: No present declared identity overlap; synthetic reference aliases and publisher speaker overlap remain unresolved.

training.optimizer: AdamW; fresh optimizer per arm; cosine LR; clip gradient norm5
training.augmentation: Unchanged original tiny augmentation: full-frame channel/gain perturbation, floor context, small feature jitter and <=4mel-bin mask; no cropping/splicing, no claim of real RIR/noise simulation.

hard_mining.source: Human TRAIN only, scored by the same epoch6 human-only foundation before any fine-tune update.
hard_mining.membership: Highest non-UNKNOWN posterior quartile within each negative scope among non-ASR-derived human references; no unreviewed whisper-derived reference receives additional hard-example amplification.
hard_mining.sampling: Balance scope then declared speaker then recording; negative_focus replaces8of16negative draws with this fixed pool. No dynamic remine, no label changes or new independent recordings.

selection.weights_and_arm: Human-dev policy-feasible accepted recall first (>=.99 precision, <=.01 negative false-accept rate and >0TP), then raw human-dev F1/precision, then synthetic-dev raw recall. Earliest epoch/arm wins exact ties. Calibration never selects weights or arm.
selection.final_policy: After selecting and locking one arm/epoch on dev only, select one global probability/margin policy requiring >=.99 precision and <=.01 negative false-accept rate in EACH human dev/calibration cohort, >0TP each; maximize minimum then mean recall. Disable if impossible; no arm switch based on calibration.
selection.quality_target: At least .90 accepted complete-command recall at .99 precision and <=.01 negative false-accept rate; historical exposed data and limited negatives cannot establish population risk or live qualification.
selection.baseline_control: Recalibrate the unchanged parent epoch44 on this same finer grid using cached human dev/cal logits, keeping original policy results separately. Do not attribute a threshold-grid-only improvement to acoustic learning.

final_evaluation.status: Previously exposed regression only, never fresh blind qualification.

preserve: All289 original protected inputs, all tiny-v1 sources/results/weights/graphs/policies, installed/submission assets, scripts/modules.json, raw audio and publisher metadata; no commit/push or live microphone/Pi/provider actions.
